name: City Council Meeting - Dark - Jul 07, 2026
agenda_text:
BURBANK CITY COUNCIL
  NOTICE OF CANCELLATION

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that there will be no Regular City Council Meeting on July 7

and July 14, 2026. The next Regular Meeting will take place on Tuesday, July 21, 2026,

in the Council Chamber of Burbank City Hall at 275 E. Olive Avenue, Burbank, CA 91502.

Dated: July 2, 2026

  _s/Kimberley Clark_______
  Kimberley Clark, City Clerk

AFFIDAVIT OF POSTING

I, Kimberley Clark, declare as follows: That I am the duly designated and qualified City Clerk for
the City of Burbank and that I cause the above notice to be posted on the Council Chamber and
the City website on July 2, 2026.

Dated: July 2, 2026  By: Kimberley Clark, City Clerk
